title: Pure Karakuri
summary: Pure Karakuri cards with untagged EARTH Machine Synchros, Xyz, and generic staples. Karakuri monsters are EARTH Machines that shift battle positions when targeted for an attack, and the deck converts every battle position change into searches, draws, Synchro climbs, and banishes.

summary.title: Starters
points: Karakuri Merchant mdl 177 "Inashichi" searches any Karakuri card from the Deck when Normal Summoned.
Karakuri Cash Cache searches a Level 4 or lower Karakuri monster and switches a face-up Karakuri you control to Defense Position.
Karakuri Bonze mdl 9763 "Kunamzan" changes a Karakuri's battle position to Special Summon itself from the hand as a Level 5 Tuner.
Karakuri Komachi mdl 224 "Ninishi" is a Level 3 Tuner that grants an additional Normal Summon of a Karakuri monster while face-up.

summary.title: Opening: Karakuri Merchant + Karakuri Bonze
steps: Normal Summon Karakuri Merchant mdl 177 "Inashichi" to search Karakuri Gama Oil or Karakuri Cash Cache, then activate Karakuri Bonze mdl 9763 "Kunamzan" in hand to flip Merchant to Defense Position and Special Summon Bonze as a Level 5 Tuner.

Synchro Summon Level 7 Karakuri Shogun mdl 00 "Burei", which Special Summons a Karakuri Tuner (such as Komachi or Strategist) from the Deck to climb into Level 8 Karakuri Steel Shogun mdl 00X "Bureido" and Level 9 Karakuri Super Shogun mdl 00N "Bureibu".
Each Shogun Special Summons another Karakuri from the Deck on Synchro Summon, ending on Bureibu, Bureido, and Karakuri Gama mdl 4624 "Shirokunishi" in the GY.

summary.title: Position-Change Engine
summary.text: Every time a Karakuri changes battle position, Karakuri Steel Shogun mdl 00X "Bureido" draws a card, Karakuri Super Shogun mdl 00N "Bureibu" banishes a card the opponent controls, and Karakuri Anatomy gains counters to draw up to two cards. Karakuri Gama mdl 4624 "Shirokunishi" banishes itself from the GY as a Quick Effect on either turn to change a Karakuri's position, triggering Bureibu's banish and Bureido's draw during the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Karakuri Super Shogun mdl 00N "Bureibu" protects all Defense Position monsters you control from battle destruction and banishes an opposing card once per turn when a Karakuri changes position.
Karakuri Cash Inn flips a Karakuri you control to negate an opposing monster's effects, and banishes itself from the GY to change a monster's position on either turn.
Karakuri Bonze locks your Extra Deck to EARTH Machines for the turn, which the three Shoguns plus Samurai Destroyer, Combat Wheel, Gaming Gamer GG, and Drill Driver Vespenato all satisfy.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Karakuri Gama Oil revives a Karakuri from the GY and permanently boosts its ATK/DEF by 500 once per turn whenever a Karakuri changes position.
Karakuri Trick House destroys a card on the field when a Karakuri monster you control changes battle position.
